gui.economy_core.shop_blurb_0: The basics. A cobble generator and a crate will get you going. Everything else, you earn.
gui.economy_core.shop_blurb_1: Gears, pots and traps. Your first real production line starts on this shelf.
gui.economy_core.shop_blurb_2: Machines that click, suck and sieve so you don't have to. Your hands will thank you.
gui.economy_core.shop_blurb_3: Frontier gear: gateways, villager blocks and the Mystical Agriculture altar.
gui.economy_core.shop_blurb_4: Power, Mekanism and machines that eat electricity for breakfast.
gui.economy_core.shop_blurb_5: Reactors, big generators and serious hardware. Mind the bill.
gui.economy_core.shop_blurb_6: The fancy stuff. You've earned it. Probably.
